notes.1592: Wholesale item names “Arabic – Latin” (JSON-LD names and img alts, 1592–1792 range): the segment is cut mid-name and the rest of the Latin name follows outside it, so I returned only the Latin part (e.g. “Carnation” + “ Zurigo”), dropping the Arabic name that duplicated it. Where the Arabic gives a different common name I kept it in front: Lisianthus – Eustoma, Orchid – Dendrobium/Cymbidium, Oak leaves – Quercus, Statice – Limonium, Waxflower – Chamelaucium.
notes.1643: Segment is only “أراليا –”; the Latin “ Aralia” follows outside it, so the result reads “Aralia – Aralia”. Same for 1644 (Ruscus) and 1758 (Scabiosa). If your merge accepts an empty string, blanking these gives a cleaner alt/name.
notes.1716: Segment is only “أوركيد أونسيديوم –” with “ Oncidium” following; returned “Orchid –” so it reads “Orchid – Oncidium”.
notes.1813: wholesale/spray-roses.html: glossary says بيبي روز → baby roses, so titles/meta/h1 (1813, 1814, 1817) say “baby roses”, but the page slug and item names say “Spray Rose”. Consider “spray roses” for this page.
